summary: Implemented prepareUpdate following the prepareQuery pattern. Changes: (1) rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py adds an Update class (prologue, algebra) alongside Query. (2) rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py adds prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None) -> Update, which parses, translates, wraps the algebra in Update, and sets _original_args; SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update now unwraps Update objects to their algebra. processUpdate is unchanged. (3) rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py exports prepareUpdate. (4) test/test_sparql.py adds test_prepare_update, which checks the type, _original_args, and reuse of one prepared INSERT DATA against two graphs. Tests were not run per instructions, so this is verified only by reading the code. Nothing committed.
